==Dialogue==
Boreas Seabed outpost:
:''"It is good to be back here in Boreas Seabed. Even we Luxons need a place to call home.''

:''The city itself is just across the Jade Quarry. There are some who live there year-round, but most Luxons prefer to travel the Jade Sea and return to Cavalon only for the Convocation, and even then we make our camp out here in the seabed rather than taking lodgings in the city."''

==Quotes==
Boreas Seabed mission:
: ''"Argo! Argo! Argo!"''

==Trivia==
* [[w:Linus (mythology)|Linus]] is a son of Apollo in Greek mythology with multiple iterations to his story, though they all focus around dirges. Given the association with the Turtle Clan and Argo, it is possible this character references [[w:Linus_(Argive)|Linus of Argos]] variation.
